repeat_survey.limits: exact-core, direct-repeat, finite-distance survey; not an exhaustive imperfect-repeat finder; no RNA expression or function inferred
repeat_survey.low_complexity: retain and label; do not promote to high-complexity evidence
repeat_survey.noncoding_label: NO_OFFICIAL_CDS_OVERLAP is annotation-relative, not proven ncRNA; require full array span and all repeat copies to be checked
repeat_survey.predicted_orf_overlap: separate predicted-CDS mask; absence of annotation never establishes absence of a gene
repeat_survey.redundancy: merge contained shifted representations with equal copy counts; preserve source-seed multiplicity
repeat_survey.scope: all 383 fixed neighborhoods independent of RT hits and scores
repeat_survey.selection: each exact seed occurrence cluster; deterministic greedy nonoverlap; maximal common exact extension within the core limit

rt_profiles.absence_interpretation: NO_HIT_IN_THIS_PROFILE_PANEL, never RT absent or non-ART
rt_profiles.auxiliary: RVT_3 alone is RT-like auxiliary evidence, not sufficient for the RT_CORE label
rt_profiles.background: one combined, frozen target universe; no data-dependent database reduction
rt_profiles.deduplication: exact amino acid SHA256 for computation only; restore all official/ORF records and candidate links
rt_profiles.primary: hmmsearch --cut_ga; an included domain in RVT_1 or RVT_2 is profile-level RT evidence, not catalytic or ART proof
rt_profiles.profile_snapshot: download only these three official Pfam HMMs; freeze ACC.version, GA values and SHA256 before scoring
